intake_facts: Government customer represented 42% of H1 2026 revenue.
As of 2026-08-05, 598.350M common shares were outstanding.
By 2026-09-15 Rocket Lab had raised ~$1.944B through sale of ~29.3M shares under the replacement ATM to fund the pending Iridium acquisition.
Iridium transaction consideration is $27 cash plus RKLB stock per share under a collar; acquisition expected to close in mid-2027 subject to approvals.
